incident: Search index corruption after node restart
symptoms: issue began after abrupt node restart
recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: A corrupted shard prevented normal index recovery.
resolution: One search shard was corrupted after an abrupt node restart. Restoring only the affected shard avoided a full reindex.
postmortem: Full cluster reindex was unnecessarily expensive.
Timeout changes did not repair the index.
